Costco's total revenue rose about 42.2% from fiscal Q1 2026 to fiscal Q4 2026. The two quarters are not the same length, so part of the increase reflects the extra weeks.

- **Q1 FY2026 revenue:** $67,307 million, from the 12 weeks ended November 23, 2025.
- **Q4 FY2026 revenue:** the filings give no standalone figure, so I derived it by subtracting the 36-week total ($207,431 million) from the full-year total ($303,154 million). That gives $95,723 million.
- **Change:** 95,723 / 67,307 − 1 ≈ 42.2%.

Q4 covers 16 weeks (the fiscal year has 52 weeks, and Q1 through Q3 cover 12 + 12 + 12 = 36 weeks), against 12 weeks for Q1.
